facts.fact: MainOne, an Equinix Company, announced the launch in November 2023 of its expanded open-access, carrier-neutral AB1.2 data centre at VITIB, Grand Bassam, which it describes as built to 'Uptime Tier III standards' and which sells colocation and interconnection to customers.
facts.system: MainOne AB1.2 data centre, VITIB, Grand Bassam

facts.fact: MainOne says customers at its Grand Bassam data centre get access to internet exchanges, including the Amsterdam Internet Exchange (AMS-IX) 'hosted at the data center'.
facts.system: AMS-IX at MainOne AB1.2 data centre

facts.fact: MainOne says it landed its submarine cable in Cote d'Ivoire before launching its first data centre there in 2019, and delivers connectivity over it.
The AB1.2 data centre at Grand Bassam is operated by MainOne, described as an Equinix Company following Equinix's acquisition of it.
